project_type: Static Vite site with Three.js 3D globe, GSAP scroll animations, deployed to GitHub Pages
test_framework: No test framework currently. Verification is via successful vite build.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install, 2. Run npm run build, 3. Verify dist/ output contains index.html and species pages, 4. Check no build errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated by vite build but is gitignored. Static JSON data files in public/data/ will be committed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full npm access available. Node.js 22 available. No Docker needed (GitHub Pages static site).
contribution_requirements: Maintain the liquid glass pastel aesthetic. Keep site fully static (no server-side). All API data pre-fetched as static JSON. Performance-conscious (lazy loading, code splitting).
key_patterns: Each section has its own JS module (hero.js, globe.js, tiger-section.js, etc). GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven animations. Glass card/panel CSS pattern (.glass-card, .glass-panel). Lazy loading via IntersectionObserver for globe. vite.config.js sets base to /species-on-screen/. CSS custom properties define the design system palette.
directory_structure: Root: index.html, vite.config.js, package.json. src/: main.js (entry), style.css (full design system), hero.js, globe.js, concept-section.js, tiger-section.js, vision-section.js, scroll-animations.js. .github/workflows/deploy.yml: GitHub Actions deployment.
